title: Great purchase
text: Great purchase. I bought 2 different sizes of these runners.  They were delivered promptly.  The colors are vivid and as shown.  The weave is tight and they lied flat almost immediately.  They have a rubbery backing, but just to be sure they stayed in place and the corners don't curl, I used heavy duty double stick tape on the corners and the middle edges.  They're easy to vacuum.  I'm very happy with this purchase.

features: Machine Made in Turkey | OekoTex Certified

LOW PROFILE: These rugs are produced with a thinner profile to avoid trip hazards for your pets and loved ones. Low profile rugs allows for a seamless transition of your cold floors to a warmer space.
Care Instructions: Vacuum regularly and spot clean with damp cloth, DO NOT machine wash. DO NOT use strong liquid cleaners or hot water.
